title: 串联 RLC 带通电路的通频带
statement: L = 0.1 H，C = 10 µF，R = 45 Ω 串联，输出取电阻电压 U_o，H(jω) = U_o/U_s。
求中心（谐振）频率 f₀；再求 ω = 1250 rad/s 时的 |H(jω)| 和相位，并由此判断通频带。

questions.ask: ω = 1250 rad/s 时 H(jω) 的相位 = ?
questions.explain: ω > ω₀，电路呈感性，电流（即 U_o）滞后 U_s：−arctan(45/45) = −45°。

questions.ask: 这个带通电路的通频带（−3 dB 带宽）BW = ?（用 Hz 表示）
questions.explain: |H| = 1/√2 的两个频率满足 |ωL − 1/(ωC)| = R，且 ω₁ω₂ = ω₀²。已知 ω₂ = 1250 rad/s，ω₁ = 10⁶/1250 = 800 rad/s。BW = ω₂ − ω₁ = 450 rad/s = R/L，换成频率 450/(2π) ≈ 71.62 Hz。

hints: |H| = 1/√2 时电抗的大小等于 R；两个半功率频率的乘积等于 ω₀²，差等于 R/L。
solution: **4. 通频带。** BW = ω₂ − ω₁ = **450 rad/s**（≈ 71.6 Hz），也可直接用公式 BW = R/L = 45/0.1 = 450 rad/s；Q = ω₀/BW = ω₀L/R = 100/45 ≈ 2.22。
R 越小 Q 越高、通带越窄、选择性越好。

en.title: Bandwidth of a series RLC band-pass circuit
statement: L = 0.1 H, C = 10 µF and R = 45 Ω are in series; the output is the resistor voltage U_o and H(jω) = U_o/U_s.
Find the centre (resonant) frequency f₀; then find |H(jω)| and its phase at ω = 1250 rad/s, and use them to determine the bandwidth.

questions.explain: ω₀ = 1/√(LC) = 1000 rad/s, f₀ ≈ 159.15 Hz. Here H = 1 (its maximum).

questions.ask: Phase of H(jω) at ω = 1250 rad/s = ?
questions.explain: Above ω₀ the circuit is inductive and the current (i.e. U_o) lags U_s: −arctan(45/45) = −45°.

questions.ask: Bandwidth (−3 dB) of this band-pass circuit, BW = ? (in Hz)
questions.explain: The two frequencies with |H| = 1/√2 satisfy |ωL − 1/(ωC)| = R and ω₁ω₂ = ω₀². With ω₂ = 1250 rad/s, ω₁ = 10⁶/1250 = 800 rad/s. BW = ω₂ − ω₁ = 450 rad/s = R/L, i.e. 450/(2π) ≈ 71.62 Hz.

hints: H(jω) = R/(R + j(ωL − 1/(ωC))); at resonance H = 1.
|H| = 1/√2 where the size of the reactance equals R; the two half-power frequencies multiply to ω₀² and differ by R/L.
solution: **1. Centre frequency.** ω₀ = 1/√(0.1 × 10⁻⁵) = 1000 rad/s, f₀ = **159.15 Hz**, H(jω₀) = 1.
**2. At ω = 1250 rad/s.** ωL = 125 Ω, 1/(ωC) = 80 Ω, X = 45 Ω. H = 45/(45 + j45) = **0.7071∠−45°**: this is exactly the upper half-power frequency ω₂.
**3. Lower half-power frequency.** From ω₁ω₂ = ω₀²: ω₁ = 800 rad/s, where X = 80 − 125 = −45 Ω and H = 0.7071∠+45°.
**4. Bandwidth.** BW = ω₂ − ω₁ = **450 rad/s** (≈ 71.6 Hz), or directly BW = R/L = 45/0.1 = 450 rad/s; Q = ω₀/BW = ω₀L/R = 100/45 ≈ 2.22.
A smaller R gives a higher Q, a narrower pass band and better selectivity.
